turns.speaker: A

turns.speaker: A

turns.speaker: A

turns.english: Please put less sugar.

turns.pinyin: Méi wèn tí, bàn táng kě yǐ ma?
turns.english: No problem, is half sugar okay?

turns.english: Okay, two cups of hot green tea coming right up.

turns.hanzi: 早上喝一杯热牛奶吧。

turns.speaker: A

turns.english: Today is so hot, do you want iced?

turns.pinyin: Duì, wǒ yào jiā hěn duō bīng.
turns.english: Yes, I want to add lots of ice.

turns.hanzi: 我们要两杯热咖啡。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ men yào liǎng bēi rè kā fēi.

turns.speaker: B

turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, yī gòng sì shí kuài.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 谢谢你的帮助。
turns.pinyin: Xiè xie nǐ de bāng zhù.
turns.english: Thank you for your help.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 不客气，欢迎下次再来。
turns.pinyin: Bù kè qi, huān yíng xià cì zài lái.
turns.english: You are welcome, welcome back next time.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 您的拿铁咖啡好了。
turns.pinyin: Nín de ná tiě kā fēi hǎo le.
turns.english: Your latte coffee is ready.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 谢谢！闻起来很香。

turns.pinyin: Nǐ yào yī bēi chá hái shi yī píng shuǐ?
turns.english: Do you want a cup of tea or a bottle of water?

turns.pinyin: Gěi wǒ yī bēi chá ba.
turns.english: Give me a cup of tea.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 我要这个巧克力蛋糕。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ yào zhè ge qiǎo kè lì dàn gāo.
turns.english: I want this chocolate cake.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，请稍等。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, qǐng shāo děng.
turns.english: Okay, please wait a moment.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请问，北京火车站怎么走？
turns.pinyin: Qǐng wèn, běi jīng huǒ chē zhàn zěn me zǒu?
turns.english: Excuse me, how do I get to Beijing Railway Station?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 往前走就是火车站了。
turns.pinyin: Wǎng qián zǒu jiù shì huǒ chē zhàn le.
turns.english: Walk straight ahead and you'll reach the station.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请出示您的车票和身份证。
turns.pinyin: Qǐng chū shì nín de chē piào hé shēn fèn zhèng.
turns.english: Please present your train ticket and ID card.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，车票在这里。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, chē piào zài zhè lǐ.
turns.english: Okay, the ticket is right here.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 哎呀，我的手机不见了！
turns.pinyin: Āi yā, wǒ de shǒu jī bù jiàn le!
turns.english: Oh no, my mobile phone is gone!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 别着急，是不是在包里？
turns.pinyin: Bié zháo jí, shì bu shì zài bāo lǐ?
turns.english: Don't worry, is it in your bag?

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 我的钱包也落在车上了吗？
turns.pinyin: Wǒ de qián bāo yě là zài chē shang ma?
turns.english: Did I leave my wallet on the vehicle too?

turns.speaker: B

turns.pinyin: Méi yǒu, qián bāo zài nǐ de kǒu dài lǐ.
turns.english: No, the wallet is in your pocket.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请问洗手间在第几层？
turns.pinyin: Qǐng wèn xǐ shǒu jiān zài dì jǐ céng?
turns.english: Excuse me, which floor is the restroom on?

turns.speaker: B

turns.english: The restroom is on the second floor to the left.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 去上海的火车在哪个站台？
turns.pinyin: Qù shàng hǎi de huǒ chē zài nǎ ge zhàn tái?
turns.english: Which platform is the train to Shanghai at?

turns.speaker: B

turns.pinyin: Qǐng qù dì sān zhàn tái hòu chē.
turns.english: Please go to Platform 3 to wait.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这个行李非常重。
turns.pinyin: Zhè ge xíng li fēi cháng zhòng.
turns.english: This luggage is very heavy.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我来帮你拿行李吧。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ lái bāng nǐ ná xíng li ba.
turns.english: Let me help you carry the luggage.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 火车几点出发？
turns.pinyin: Huǒ chē jǐ diǎn chū fā?
turns.english: What time does the train depart?

turns.speaker: B

turns.english: The train departs on time at 10 AM.

turns.speaker: A

turns.pinyin: Shòu piào chù zài shén me dì fang?

turns.speaker: B

turns.pinyin: Zài huǒ chē zhàn dà mén páng biān.
turns.english: Next to the railway station main gate.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 哎呀，我们的车快开了！
turns.pinyin: Āi yā, wǒ men de chē kuài kāi le!
turns.english: Oh no, our train is about to depart!

turns.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo tiān měi, wǒ jiào wáng míng.
turns.english: Hello Tianmei, my name is Wang Ming.

turns.speaker: A

turns.pinyin: Dà jiā hǎo, wǒ jiào zhāng huá.
turns.english: Hello everyone, my name is Zhang Hua.

turns.pinyin: Huān yíng zhāng huá jiā rù wǒ men bān.

turns.pinyin: Wáng míng shì wǒ de xīn tóng xué.

turns.english: The history teacher speaks very interestingly.

turns.pinyin: Jīn tiān bù yòng shàng shù xué kè le.

turns.hanzi: 那今天会比较忙。
turns.pinyin: Nà jīn tiān huì bǐ jiào máng.

turns.speaker: A

turns.english: Are you going to the gym to work out today?

turns.pinyin: Fēi cháng xǐ huan, yóu yǒng hěn shū fu.

turns.pinyin: Jīn tiān zǎo shang gōng yuán lǐ pǎo bù de rén zhēn duō.

turns.speaker: A

turns.pinyin: Jīng cháng yùn dòng duì shēn tǐ fēi cháng hǎo.

turns.pinyin: Fēi cháng xǐ huan, wǒ shì xiào duì de.

turns.english: Yes, natural light is great, very comfortable to live in.

turns.hanzi: 我们可以放很多水果和饮料。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ men kě yǐ fàng hěn duō shuǐ guǒ hé yǐn liào.

turns.pinyin: Nǐ de wò shì fàng de xià yī zhāng dà chuáng ma?
turns.english: Can your bedroom fit a big bed?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 卧室很大，放得下一张大床。
turns.pinyin: Wò shì hěn dà, fàng de xià yī zhāng dà chuáng.
turns.english: The bedroom is very big, fits a big bed.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你的房间怎么这么乱？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ de fáng jiān zěn me zhè me luàn?
turns.english: How is your room so messy?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我马上打扫干净。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ mǎ shàng dǎ sǎo gān jìng.
turns.english: I'll clean it up right away.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你喜欢这个新厨房吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ xǐ huan zhè ge xīn chú fáng ma?
turns.english: Do you like this new kitchen?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 喜欢，做饭非常方便。
turns.pinyin: Xǐ huan, zuò fàn fēi cháng fāng biàn.
turns.english: Yes, cooking is very convenient.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 晚上我们在客厅看电视吧。
turns.pinyin: Wǎn shang wǒ men zài kè tīng kàn diàn shì ba.
turns.english: Let's watch television in the living room tonight.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好啊，今晚有精彩的电影。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo a, jīn wǎn yǒu jīng cǎi de diàn yǐng.
turns.english: Sure, there is a wonderful movie tonight.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这张旧桌子还要吗？
turns.pinyin: Zhè zhāng jiù zhuō zi hái yào ma?
turns.english: Do you still want this old table?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 不要了，我想换一张新的。
turns.pinyin: Bù yào le, wǒ xiǎng huàn yī zhāng xīn de.
turns.english: No more, I want to change for a new one.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 昨晚睡得舒服吗？
turns.pinyin: Zuó wǎn shuì de shū fu ma?
turns.english: Did you sleep comfortably last night?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 非常舒服，床很软。
turns.pinyin: Fēi cháng shū fu, chuáng hěn ruǎn.
turns.english: Very comfortable, the bed is very soft.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 哇！你的房子真漂亮！
turns.pinyin: Wa! Nǐ de fáng zi zhēn piào liang!
turns.english: Wow! Your house is really beautiful!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 谢谢，请进客厅坐吧。
turns.pinyin: Xiè xie, qǐng jìn kè tīng zuò ba.
turns.english: Thanks, please come in and sit in the living room.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 北京烤鸭特别好吃。
turns.pinyin: Běi jīng kǎo yā tè bié hǎo chī.
turns.english: Beijing roast duck is especially delicious.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，这是北京最有名的菜。
turns.pinyin: Duì, zhè shì běi jīng zuì yǒu míng de cài.
turns.english: Yes, this is Beijing's most famous dish.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 去长城远不远？
turns.pinyin: Qù cháng chéng yuǎn bu yuǎn?
turns.english: Is going to the Great Wall far?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 有点儿远，坐大巴要一个多小时。
turns.pinyin: Yǒu diǎnr yuǎn, zuò dà bā yào yī ge duō xiǎo shí.
turns.english: A bit far, takes over an hour by bus.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 故宫的门票贵不贵？
turns.pinyin: Gù gōng de mén piào guì bu guì?
turns.english: Are tickets to the Forbidden City expensive?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 不贵，一张门票六十块。
turns.pinyin: Bù guì, yī zhāng mén piào liù shí kuài.
turns.english: Not expensive, sixty yuan a ticket.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 冬天吃火锅真舒服！
turns.pinyin: Dōng tiān chī huǒ guō zhēn shū fu!
turns.english: Eating hot pot in winter is really wonderful!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 这个锅底有点儿辣，但是很好吃。
turns.pinyin: Zhè ge guō dǐ yǒu diǎnr là, dàn shì hěn hǎo chī.
turns.english: This pot base is a bit spicy, but very delicious.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 北京的冬天冷不冷？
turns.pinyin: Běi jīng de dōng tiān lěng bu lěng?
turns.english: Is Beijing's winter cold?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 冬天非常冷，经常下雪。
turns.pinyin: Dōng tiān fēi cháng lěng, jīng cháng xià xuě.
turns.english: Winter is very cold, often snows.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 北京动物园里有大熊猫吗？
turns.pinyin: Běi jīng dòng wù yuán lǐ yǒu dà xióng māo ma?
turns.english: Are there giant pandas in Beijing Zoo?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 有，这里的动物园很好玩儿。
turns.pinyin: Yǒu, zhè lǐ de dòng wù yuán hěn hǎo wánr.
turns.english: Yes, the zoo here is very fun.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 王府井大街真热闹！
turns.pinyin: Wáng fǔ jǐng dà jiē zhēn rè nao!
turns.english: Wangfujing Street is really lively!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 人们都在这里买东西和散步。
turns.pinyin: Rén men dōu zài zhè lǐ mǎi dōng xi hé sàn bù.
turns.english: People are all shopping and strolling here.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 北京秋天的时候天气最好。
turns.pinyin: Běi jīng qiū tiān de shí hou tiān qì zuì hǎo.
turns.english: The weather is best in Beijing during autumn.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，秋天不冷也不热。
turns.pinyin: Duì, qiū tiān bù lěng yě bù rè.
turns.english: Right, autumn is neither cold nor hot.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你的老家也在北方吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ de lǎo jiā yě zài běi fāng ma?
turns.english: Is your hometown also in the north?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 不，我的老家在四川成都。
turns.pinyin: Bù, wǒ de lǎo jiā zài sì chuān chéng dū.
turns.english: No, my hometown is in Chengdu, Sichuan.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 故宫是世界上很有名的建筑。
turns.pinyin: Gù gōng shì shì jiè shang hěn yǒu míng de jiàn zhù.
turns.english: The Forbidden City is world-famous architecture.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 确实特别壮观。
turns.pinyin: Què shí tè bié zhuàng guān.
turns.english: Indeed especially magnificent.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 周末你有空儿吗？一起看电影吧。
turns.pinyin: Zhōu mò nǐ yǒu kòngr ma? Yī qǐ kàn diàn yǐng ba.
turns.english: Do you have free time this weekend? Let's watch a movie together.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，我想看那部爱情电影。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ xiǎng kàn nà bù ài qíng diàn yǐng.
turns.english: Okay, I want to watch that romance movie.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 买一桶爆米花和两杯果汁吧。
turns.pinyin: Mǎi yī tǒng bào mǐ huā hé liǎng bēi guǒ zhī ba.
turns.english: Let's buy a bucket of popcorn and two juices.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好，爆米花配果汁最好吃。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo, bào mǐ huā pèi guǒ zhī zuì hǎo chī.
turns.english: Great, popcorn with juice is the best.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 我们坐地铁去国家博物馆吧。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ men zuò dì tiě qù guó jiā bó wù guǎn ba.
turns.english: Let's take the subway to the National Museum.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好，坐地铁比较快。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo, zuò dì tiě bǐ jiào kuài.
turns.english: Okay, taking the subway is faster.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这个历史博物馆很大。
turns.pinyin: Zhè ge lì shǐ bó wù guǎn hěn dà.
turns.english: This history museum is very large.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，里面有很多古代文物。
turns.pinyin: Duì, lǐ miàn yǒu hěn duō gǔ dài wén wù.
turns.english: Yes, there are many ancient relics inside.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 晚饭我们吃牛肉饺子怎么样？
turns.pinyin: Wǎn fàn wǒ men chī niú ròu jiǎo zi zěn me yàng?
turns.english: How about eating beef dumplings for dinner?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 太好了，我最喜欢饺子。
turns.pinyin: Tài hǎo le, wǒ zuì xǐ huan jiǎo zi.
turns.english: Awesome, I like dumplings the most.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 尝尝这个草莓蛋糕，非常甜。
turns.pinyin: Cháng chang zhè ge cǎo méi dàn gāo.
turns.english: Taste this strawberry cake, very sweet.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 真好吃，蛋糕做得很棒。
turns.pinyin: Zhēn hǎo chī, dàn gāo zuò de hěn bàng.
turns.english: Really delicious, the cake was made great.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 我想买一些新鲜水果。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī xiē xīn xiān shuǐ guǒ.
turns.english: I want to buy some fresh fruit.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 今天的苹果和西瓜都很甜。
turns.pinyin: Jīn tiān de píng guǒ hé xī guā dōu hěn tián.
turns.english: Today's apples and watermelons are both sweet.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请给我一杯新鲜橙汁果汁。
turns.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yī bēi xīn xiān chéng zhī guǒ zhī.
turns.english: Please give me a cup of fresh orange juice.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，请稍等两分钟。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, qǐng shāo děng liǎng fēn zhōng.
turns.english: Okay, please wait two minutes.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 坐公交车去学校方便吗？
turns.pinyin: Zuò gōng jiāo chē qù xué xiào fāng biàn ma?
turns.english: Is taking the bus to school convenient?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 很方便，车站就在门前。
turns.pinyin: Hěn fāng biàn, chē zhàn jiù zài mén qián.
turns.english: Very convenient, the stop is right in front of the gate.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 今晚我们一起吃晚饭吧。
turns.pinyin: Jīn wǎn wǒ men yī qǐ chī wǎn fàn ba.
turns.english: Let's eat dinner together tonight.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，七点在饭馆见。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, qī diǎn zài fàn guǎn jiàn.
turns.english: Okay, see you at the restaurant at seven.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 做晚饭需要西红柿和土豆。
turns.pinyin: Zuò wǎn fàn xū yào xī hóng shì hé tǔ dòu.
turns.english: Cooking dinner requires tomatoes and potatoes.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，我先去洗蔬菜。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ xiān qù xǐ shū cài.
turns.english: Okay, I'll go wash the vegetables first.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 切土豆的时候小心手。
turns.pinyin: Qiē tǔ dòu de shí hou xiǎo xīn shǒu.
turns.english: Be careful with your hands when cutting potatoes.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 放心吧，我会小心的。
turns.pinyin: Fàng xīn ba, wǒ huì xiǎo xīn de.
turns.english: Don't worry, I will be careful.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 汤里放一点儿盐了吗？
turns.pinyin: Tāng lǐ fàng yī diǎnr yán le ma?
turns.english: Did you put a little salt in the soup?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 已经放了盐，味道刚好。
turns.pinyin: Yǐ jīng fàng le yán, wèi dào gāng hǎo.
turns.english: Already put salt, the taste is just right.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 脏盘子放进洗碗机了吗？
turns.pinyin: Zāng pán zi fàng jìn xǐ wǎn jī le ma?
turns.english: Did you put the dirty plates into the dishwasher?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 都放好了，洗碗机正在洗。
turns.pinyin: Dōu fàng hǎo le, xǐ wǎn jī zhèng zài xǐ.
turns.english: All put in, the dishwasher is washing.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请把筷子和盘子摆好。
turns.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ kuài zi hé pán zi bǎi hǎo.
turns.english: Please arrange the chopsticks and plates.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，我再拿四个碗。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ zài ná sì ge wǎn.
turns.english: Okay, I'll fetch four more bowls.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 吃饭前先去洗手。
turns.pinyin: Chī fàn qián xiān qù xǐ shǒu.
turns.english: Go wash hands before eating.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好，我已经擦干净手了。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ yǐ jīng cā gān jìng shǒu le.
turns.english: Okay, I've already wiped my hands clean.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 爷爷，您尝尝这个牛肉。
turns.pinyin: Yé ye, nín cháng chang zhè ge niú ròu.
turns.english: Grandpa, try this beef.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 真香，今天的肉很好吃。
turns.pinyin: Zhēn xiāng, jīn tiān de ròu hěn hǎo chī.
turns.english: Really fragrant, today's meat is very good.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 吃完饭可以吃冰淇淋吗？
turns.pinyin: Chī wán fàn kě yǐ chī bīng qí lín ma?
turns.english: Can I have ice cream after eating?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 可以，冰箱里有香草冰淇淋。
turns.pinyin: Kě yǐ, bīng xiāng lǐ yǒu xiāng cǎo bīng qí lín.
turns.english: Yes, there is vanilla ice cream in the fridge.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请用抹布擦一下桌子。
turns.pinyin: Qǐng yòng mā bù cā yī xià zhuō zi.
turns.english: Please wipe the table with a rag.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好，马上擦干净。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo, mǎ shàng cā gān jìng.
turns.english: Okay, wiping it clean right away.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你经常在家里做饭吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ jīng cháng zài jiā lǐ zuò fàn ma?
turns.english: Do you often cook at home?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，自己做饭健康又省钱。
turns.pinyin: Duì, zì jǐ zuò fàn jiàn kāng yòu shěng qián.
turns.english: Yes, cooking for yourself is healthy and saves money.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你会弹吉他还是弹钢琴？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ huì tán jí tā hái shi tán gāng qín?
turns.english: Can you play guitar or play piano?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我弹吉他弹得很好。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ tán jí tā tán de hěn hǎo.
turns.english: I play guitar very well.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你每天练习弹钢琴吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ měi tiān liàn xí tán gāng qín ma?
turns.english: Do you practice playing piano every day?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，我每天弹一个小时。
turns.pinyin: Duì, wǒ měi tiān tán yī ge xiǎo shí.
turns.english: Yes, I play for one hour every day.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 下午我们一起去踢足球吧！
turns.pinyin: Xià wǔ wǒ men yī qǐ qù tī zú qiú ba!
turns.english: Let's go play soccer together this afternoon!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好啊，足球场见！
turns.pinyin: Hǎo a, zú qiú chǎng jiàn!
turns.english: Great, see you on the soccer field!

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你参加学校的棒球俱乐部了吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ cān jiā xué xiào de bàng qiú jù lè bù le ma?
turns.english: Did you join the school baseball club?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 参加了，棒球非常有趣。
turns.pinyin: Cān jiā le, bàng qiú fēi cháng yǒu qù.
turns.english: I joined, baseball is very interesting.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 烤箱里的巧克力饼干烤好了。
turns.pinyin: Kǎo xiāng lǐ de qiǎo kè lì bǐng gān kǎo hǎo le.
turns.english: The chocolate cookies in the oven are baked.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 闻起来真香，拿出来尝尝。
turns.pinyin: Wén qǐ lai zhēn xiāng, ná chū lai cháng chang.
turns.english: Smells so fragrant, take them out to taste.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这个新鲜面包多少钱？
turns.pinyin: Zhè ge xīn xiān miàn bāo duō shao qián?
turns.english: How much is this fresh bread?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 十五块一个，刚烤出来的。
turns.pinyin: Shí wǔ kuài yī ge, gāng kǎo chū lai de.
turns.english: Fifteen yuan each, freshly baked.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你在学西班牙语吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ zài xué xī bān yá yǔ ma?
turns.english: Are you learning Spanish?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，西班牙语很有趣。
turns.pinyin: Duì, xī bān yá yǔ hěn yǒu qù.
turns.english: Yes, Spanish is very interesting.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 法语的发音难不难？
turns.pinyin: Fǎ yǔ de fā yīn nán bu nán?
turns.english: Is French pronunciation difficult?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 有点儿难，需要多练习。
turns.pinyin: Yǒu diǎnr nán, xū yào duō liàn xí.
turns.english: A bit difficult, requires lots of practice.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 今晚有一场喜剧演出。
turns.pinyin: Jīn wǎn yǒu yī chǎng xǐ jù yǎn chū.
turns.english: There is a comedy show tonight.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 太好了，我最喜欢看喜剧。
turns.pinyin: Tài hǎo le, wǒ zuì xǐ huan kàn xǐ jù.
turns.english: Great, I like watching comedy the most.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你想加入什么俱乐部？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng jiā rù shén me jù lè bù?
turns.english: What club do you want to join?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我想加入音乐俱乐部。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng jiā rù yīn yuè jù lè bù.
turns.english: I want to join the music club.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 哥哥，我可以借你的电脑吗？
turns.pinyin: Gē ge, wǒ kě yǐ jiè nǐ de diàn nǎo ma?
turns.english: Older brother, may I borrow your computer?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 可以，但只能玩半小时游戏。
turns.pinyin: Kě yǐ, dàn zhǐ néng wán bàn xiǎo shí yóu xì.
turns.english: You may, but only play games for half an hour.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 姐姐，这只小兔子真可爱！
turns.pinyin: Jiě jie, zhè zhī xiǎo tù zi zhēn kě ài!
turns.english: Older sister, this little rabbit is so cute!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我们可以在家里养它吗？
turns.pinyin: Wǒ men kě yǐ zài jiā lǐ yǎng tā ma?
turns.english: Can we raise it at home?

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你家的狗很聪明。
turns.pinyin: Nǐ jiā de gǒu hěn cōng ming.
turns.english: Your dog is very smart.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，它每天陪我出去散步。
turns.pinyin: Duì, tā měi tiān péi wǒ chū qù sàn bù.
turns.english: Yes, it accompanies me out for walks every day.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 今天加班太累了，休息一下吧。
turns.pinyin: Jīn tiān jiā bān tài lèi le, xiū xi yī xià ba.
turns.english: Working overtime today is too tiring, take a rest.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，我们喝杯咖啡休息十分钟。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ men hē bēi kā fēi xiū xi shí fēn zhōng.
turns.english: Okay, let's drink a coffee and rest for ten minutes.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 我可以吃一块黑巧克力吗？
turns.pinyin: Wǒ kě yǐ chī yī kuài hēi qiǎo kè lì ma?
turns.english: Can I eat a piece of dark chocolate?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 可以，吃完记得刷牙。
turns.pinyin: Kě yǐ, chī wán jì de shuā yá.
turns.english: You may, remember to brush teeth after eating.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 周末我们去大商场买衣服吧。
turns.pinyin: Zhōu mò wǒ men qù dà shāng chǎng mǎi yī fu ba.
turns.english: Let's go to the big shopping mall to buy clothes this weekend.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 商场今天打折，人肯定很多。
turns.pinyin: Shāng chǎng jīn tiān dǎ zhé, rén kěn dìng hěn duō.
turns.english: The mall has discounts today, definitely crowded.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 房间里有点儿闷，开窗户吧。
turns.pinyin: Fáng jiān lǐ yǒu diǎnr mèn, kāi chuāng hu ba.
turns.english: A bit stuffy in the room, open the window.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，打开窗户透透气。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, dǎ kāi chuāng hu tòu tou qì.
turns.english: Okay, open the window for fresh air.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请把地上的玩具收起来。
turns.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ dì shang de wán jù shōu qǐ lai.
turns.english: Please pack up the toys on the floor.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的妈妈，我放到箱子里。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de mā ma, wǒ fàng dào xiāng zi lǐ.
turns.english: Okay Mom, I'll put them into the box.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 地上很脏，我来扫一下地。
turns.pinyin: Dì shang hěn zāng, wǒ lái sǎo yī xià dì.
turns.english: The floor is dirty, let me sweep the floor.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 扫完之后我用拖把拖地。
turns.pinyin: Sǎo wán zhī hòu wǒ yòng tuō bǎ tuō dì.
turns.english: After sweeping I will mop the floor with a mop.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 打完篮球喝一罐冰可乐真爽！
turns.pinyin: Dǎ wán lán qiú hē yī guàn bīng kě lè zhēn shuǎng!
turns.english: Drinking a can of cold cola after basketball is so refreshing!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 少喝可乐，对牙齿不好。
turns.pinyin: Shǎo hē kě lè, duì yá chǐ bù hǎo.
turns.english: Drink less cola, bad for teeth.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这个吸尘器非常好用。
turns.pinyin: Zhè ge xī chén qì fēi cháng hǎo yòng.
turns.english: This vacuum cleaner is very easy to use.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 地毯上的灰尘都吸干净了。
turns.pinyin: Dì tǎn shang de huī chén dōu xī gān jìng le.
turns.english: All dust on the carpet is vacuumed clean.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 书桌上的台灯很亮很舒服。
turns.pinyin: Shū zhuō shang de tái dēng hěn liàng hěn shū fu.
turns.english: The desk lamp on the desk is bright and comfortable.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 晚上看书眼睛不会累。
turns.pinyin: Wǎn shang kàn shū yǎn jing bù huì lèi.
turns.english: Eyes won't get tired reading at night.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这个新书架可以放很多书。
turns.pinyin: Zhè ge xīn shū jià kě yǐ fàng hěn duō shū.
turns.english: This new bookshelf can hold many books.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，我们把它放在客厅角落吧。
turns.pinyin: Duì, wǒ men bǎ tā fàng zài kè tīng jiǎo luò ba.
turns.english: Right, let's put it in the living room corner.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请给我一双筷子和一个勺子。
turns.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yī shuāng kuài zi hé yī ge sháo zi.
turns.english: Please give me a pair of chopsticks and a spoon.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，筷子和勺子马上送来。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, kuài zi hé sháo zi mǎ shàng sòng lái.
turns.english: Okay, chopsticks and spoon brought right over.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 喝热汤需要一个大勺子。
turns.pinyin: Hē rè tāng xū yào yī ge dà sháo zi.
turns.english: Drinking hot soup requires a big spoon.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 这里有勺子，给你。
turns.pinyin: Zhè lǐ yǒu sháo zi, gěi nǐ.
turns.english: Here is a spoon, for you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 楼上的邻居晚上有点儿吵。
turns.pinyin: Lóu shàng de lín jū wǎn shang yǒu diǎnr chǎo.
turns.english: The upstairs neighbors are a bit noisy at night.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我们可以友好地跟他们沟通一下。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ men kě yǐ yǒu hǎo de gēn tā men gōu tōng yī xià.
turns.english: We can communicate with them friendly.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你的新室友怎么样？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ de xīn shì yǒu zěn me yàng?
turns.english: How is your new roommate?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我的室友非常爱干净，很好相处。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ de shì yǒu fēi cháng ài gān jìng, hěn hǎo xiāng chǔ.
turns.english: My roommate loves cleanliness, very easy to get along with.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这些旧纸箱可以扔掉吗？
turns.pinyin: Zhè xiē jiù zhǐ xiāng kě yǐ rēng diào ma?
turns.english: Can these old cardboard boxes be thrown away?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 可以，都扔到垃圾桶里吧。
turns.pinyin: Kě yǐ, dōu rēng dào lā jī tǒng lǐ ba.
turns.english: Yes, throw them all into the trash bin.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这顶红色的帽子真好看！
turns.pinyin: Zhè dǐng hóng sè de mào zi zhēn hǎo kàn!
turns.english: This red hat looks really nice!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 谢谢，冬天戴它非常暖和。
turns.pinyin: Xiè xie, dōng tiān dài tā fēi cháng nuǎn huo.
turns.english: Thanks, wearing it in winter is very warm.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这些脏衣服需要洗一下了。
turns.pinyin: Zhè xiē zāng yī fu xū yào xǐ yī xià le.
turns.english: These dirty clothes need to be washed.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，我放进洗衣机里洗。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ fàng jìn xǐ yī jī lǐ xǐ.
turns.english: Okay, I'll put them into the washing machine.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 星期六早上我们吃什么早饭？
turns.pinyin: Xīng qī liù zǎo shang wǒ men chī shén me zǎo fàn?
turns.english: What breakfast do we eat on Saturday morning?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我们吃鸡蛋和面包吧。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ men chī jī dàn hé miàn bāo ba.
turns.english: Let's eat eggs and bread.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 妹妹正在房间里拉小提琴。
turns.pinyin: Mèi mei zhèng zài fáng jiān lǐ lā xiǎo tí qín.
turns.english: Younger sister is playing violin in the room.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 她拉小提琴拉得真好听。
turns.pinyin: Tā lā xiǎo tí qín lā de zhēn hǎo tīng.
turns.english: She plays the violin really melodiously.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你喜欢听摇滚音乐吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ xǐ huan tīng yáo gǔn yīn yuè?
turns.english: Do you like listening to rock music?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 非常喜欢，节奏很有力量。
turns.pinyin: Fēi cháng xǐ huan, jié zòu hěn yǒu lì liang.
turns.english: Very much, the rhythm is full of power.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 今天天气真好，去草地上玩飞盘吧！
turns.pinyin: Jīn tiān tiān qì zhēn hǎo, qù cǎo dì shang wán fēi pán ba!
turns.english: Weather is great today, let's play frisbee on the grass!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好啊，玩飞盘运动量很大。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo a, wán fēi pán yùn dòng liàng hěn dà.
turns.english: Sure, playing frisbee is a great workout.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 喂，请问王明在家吗？
turns.pinyin: Wèi, qǐng wèn wáng míng zài jiā ma?
turns.english: Hello, is Wang Ming at home?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 是我，我正在上网查资料呢。
turns.pinyin: Shì wǒ, wǒ zhèng zài shàng wǎng chá zī liào ne.
turns.english: It's me, I'm surfing the internet looking up info.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你今天上网上了多长时间？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ jīn tiān shàng wǎng shàng le duō cháng shí jiān?
turns.english: How long have you surfed the internet today?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 才半个小时，我马上写作业。
turns.pinyin: Cái bàn ge xiǎo shí, wǒ mǎ shàng xiě zuò yè.
turns.english: Only half an hour, I will do homework right away.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 爸爸，您在看今天的报纸吗？
turns.pinyin: Bà ba, nín zài kàn jīn tiān de bào zhǐ ma?
turns.english: Dad, are you reading today's newspaper?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，看早间的新闻报道。
turns.pinyin: Duì, kàn zǎo jiān de xīn wén bào dào.
turns.english: Yes, reading the morning news reports.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 那个穿红裙子的小女孩儿是谁？
turns.pinyin: Nà ge chuān hóng qún zi de xiǎo nǚ háir shì shéi?
turns.english: Who is that little girl wearing a red dress?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 那是我最可爱的小妹妹。
turns.pinyin: Nà shì wǒ zuì kě ài de xiǎo mèi mei.
turns.english: That is my cutest little sister.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你需要我的帮助吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ xū yào wǒ de bāng zhù ma?
turns.english: Do you need my help?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 谢谢你，现在不需要了。
turns.pinyin: Xiè xie nǐ, xiàn zài bù xū yào le.
turns.english: Thank you, no need right now.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 很晚了，快点去睡觉吧。
turns.pinyin: Hěn wǎn le, kuài diǎn qù shuì jiào ba.
turns.english: It's late, quickly go to sleep.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的妈妈，晚安。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de mā ma, wǎn ān.
turns.english: Okay Mom, good night.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你怎么了？脸色看起来不好。
turns.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me le? Liǎn sè kàn qǐ lai bù hǎo.
turns.english: What's the matter? Your complexion looks unwell.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我头疼，肚子也很不舒服。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ tóu téng, dù zi yě hěn bù shū fu.
turns.english: I have a headache, and my stomach feels very unwell.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 李经理，我发烧了，今天想请假。
turns.pinyin: Lǐ jīng lǐ, wǒ fā shāo le, jīn tiān xiǎng qǐng jià.
turns.english: Manager Li, I have a fever and want to request leave today.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，你好好休息，下午去医院看看。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, nǐ hǎo hāo xiū xi, xià wǔ qù yī yuàn kàn kan.
turns.english: Okay, rest well and visit the hospital this afternoon.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 先量一下体温，三十八度五，发烧了。
turns.pinyin: Xiān liáng yī xià tǐ wēn, sān shí bā dù wǔ, fā shāo le.
turns.english: First let's measure temperature: 38.5 degrees, you have a fever.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 医生，我应该吃什么药？
turns.pinyin: Yī shēng, wǒ yīng gāi chī shén me yào?
turns.english: Doctor, what medicine should I take?

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这是在药店买的感冒药，饭后吃。
turns.pinyin: Zhè shì zài yào diàn mǎi de gǎn mào yào, fàn hòu chī.
turns.english: This is cold medicine from the pharmacy, take after meals.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，一次应该吃几粒？
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, yī cì yīng gāi chī jǐ lì?
turns.english: Okay, how many pills should I take each time?

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 送给你一束花，希望你开心起来。
turns.pinyin: Sòng gěi nǐ yī shù huā, xī wàng nǐ kāi xīn qǐ lai.
turns.english: Giving you a bouquet of flowers, hope you feel happier.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 谢谢你来看我，花很香！
turns.pinyin: Xiè xie nǐ lái kàn wǒ, huā hěn xiāng!
turns.english: Thank you for visiting me, the flowers smell great!

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你生病了，我早上煮了热粥给你喝。
turns.pinyin: Nǐ shēng bìng le, wǒ zǎo shang zhǔ le rè zhōu gěi nǐ hē.
turns.english: You are sick, I boiled hot porridge this morning for you.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 谢谢妈妈，热粥喝了很舒服。
turns.pinyin: Xiè xie mā ma, rè zhōu hē le hěn shū fu.
turns.english: Thanks Mom, hot porridge felt so comforting.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你肚子疼了多长时间？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ dù zi téng le duō cháng shí jiān?
turns.english: How long has your stomach been hurting?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 昨天晚上吃完饭就开始疼了。
turns.pinyin: Zuó tiān wǎn shang chī wán fàn jiù kāi shǐ téng le.
turns.english: It started hurting yesterday evening after dinner.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 过来量一下体温，看看退烧没有。
turns.pinyin: Guò lai liáng yī xià tǐ wēn, kàn kan tuì shāo méi yǒu.
turns.english: Come over and measure your temperature to see if fever broke.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 体温正常了，三十六度八。
turns.pinyin: Tǐ wēn zhèng cháng le, sān shí liù dù bā.
turns.english: Temperature is normal now, 36.8 degrees.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 老师，我身体不舒服，想请两天的假。
turns.pinyin: Lǎo shī, wǒ shēn tǐ bù shū fu, xiǎng qǐng liǎng tiān de jià.
turns.english: Teacher, I feel unwell and want to request 2 days of leave.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，去医院好好检查一下。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, qù yī yuàn hǎo hāo jiǎn chá yī xià.
turns.english: Okay, go to the hospital and get properly checked.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请问人民医院怎么走？
turns.pinyin: Qǐng wèn rén mín yī yuàn zěn me zǒu?
turns.english: Excuse me, how do I get to People's Hospital?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 坐这辆公交车两站就到医院了。
turns.pinyin: Zuò zhè liàng gōng jiāo chē liǎng zhàn jiù dào yī yuàn le.
turns.english: Take this bus for two stops to arrive at the hospital.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 明天是王明的生日，我们办个派对吧！
turns.pinyin: Míng tiān shì wáng míng de shēng rì, wǒ men bàn ge pài duì ba!
turns.english: Tomorrow is Wang Ming's birthday, let's throw a party!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好主意，我们给他准备一个大惊喜。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo zhǔ yi, wǒ men gěi tā zhǔn bèi yī ge dà jīng xǐ.
turns.english: Great idea, let's prepare a big surprise for him.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 生日蛋糕上插了五根蜡烛。
turns.pinyin: Shēng rì dàn gāo shang chā le wǔ gēn là zhú.
turns.english: Five candles were placed on the birthday cake.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 点亮蜡烛，大家一起唱生日快乐歌！
turns.pinyin: Diǎn liàng là zhú, dà jiā yī qǐ chàng shēng rì kuài lè gē!
turns.english: Light the candles, let's all sing Happy Birthday together!

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 客厅里挂满了红色的气球。
turns.pinyin: Kè tīng lǐ guà mǎn le hóng sè de qì qiú.
turns.english: The living room is hung full of red balloons.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 看起来真喜庆，派对快开始了。
turns.pinyin: Kàn qǐ lai zhēn xǐ qìng, pài duì kuài kāi shǐ le.
turns.english: Looks so festive, the party is about to start.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 我给老婆准备了一条项链做生日礼物。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ gěi lǎo po zhǔn bèi le yī tiáo xiàng liàn zuò shēng rì lǐ wù.
turns.english: I prepared a necklace for my wife as a birthday gift.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 这条项链真精致，她一定很喜欢。
turns.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiàng liàn zhēn jīng zhì, tā yī dìng hěn xǐ huan.
turns.english: This necklace is so delicate, she will surely like it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这条蓝色的领带送给爸爸。
turns.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lán sè de lǐng dài sòng gěi bà ba.
turns.english: This blue necktie is for Dad.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 颜色很配他的白衬衫。
turns.pinyin: Yán sè hěn pèi tā de bái chèn shān.
turns.english: The color matches his white shirt well.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 冬天到了，送给奶奶一条暖和的围巾。
turns.pinyin: Dōng tiān dào le, sòng gěi nǎi nai yī tiáo nuǎn huo de wéi jīn.
turns.english: Winter has arrived, gifting Grandma a warm scarf.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 谢谢乖孙子，围巾戴着真舒服。
turns.pinyin: Xiè xie guāi sūn zi, wéi jīn dài zhe zhēn shū fu.
turns.english: Thank you good grandson, the scarf feels so comfortable.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 桌上准备了薯片和饮料。
turns.pinyin: Zhuō shang zhǔn bèi le shǔ piàn hé yǐn liào.
turns.english: Potato chips and drinks are prepared on the table.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 太棒了，大家边吃边聊天吧。
turns.pinyin: Tài bàng le, dà jiā biān chī biān liáo tiān ba.
turns.english: Awesome, let's eat and chat together.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 我们邀请了十个朋友来参加派对。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ men yāo qǐng le shí ge péng you lái cān jiā pài duì.
turns.english: We invited ten friends to attend the party.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 大家都说星期天一定过来。
turns.pinyin: Dà jiā dōu shuō xīng qī tiān yī dìng guò lai.
turns.english: Everyone said they'll definitely come on Sunday.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 过生日一定要吃一条鱼，年年有余。
turns.pinyin: Guò shēng rì yī dìng yào chī yī tiáo yú, nián nián yǒu yú.
turns.english: Must eat a fish on birthdays, abundance year after year.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 这个红烧鱼做得很鲜美。
turns.pinyin: Zhè ge hóng shāo yú zuò de hěn xiān měi.
turns.english: This braised fish was cooked very delicious.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 我们不要告诉王明，给他一个惊喜！
turns.pinyin: Wǒ men bù yào gào su wáng míng, gěi tā yī ge jīng xǐ.
turns.english: Let's not tell Wang Ming, give him a surprise!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，派对一定特别好玩儿。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, pài duì yī dìng tè bié hǎo wánr.
turns.english: Okay, the party will definitely be super fun.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请问学校的体育馆怎么走？
turns.pinyin: Qǐng wèn xué xiào de tǐ yù guǎn zěn me zǒu?
turns.english: Excuse me, how do I get to the school gym?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 沿着前面这条路走，图书馆旁边就是体育馆。
turns.pinyin: Yán zhe qián miàn zhè tiáo lù zǒu, tú shū guǎn páng biān jiù shì tǐ yù guǎn.
turns.english: Walk along this road ahead, the gym is next to the library.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 学校图书馆里面非常安静。
turns.pinyin: Xué xiào tú shū guǎn lǐ miàn fēi cháng ān jìng.
turns.english: Inside the school library it is very quiet.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，很适合晚上在那里复习功课。
turns.pinyin: Duì, hěn shì hé wǎn shang zài nà lǐ fù xí gōng kè.
turns.english: Yes, very suitable for reviewing homework there at night.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 今天中午去第一食堂吃饭吧。
turns.pinyin: Jīn tiān zhōng wǔ qù dì yī shí táng chī fàn ba.
turns.english: Let's go eat at No. 1 cafeteria this noon.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好，食堂的包子和面条很便宜。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo, shí táng de bāo zi hé miàn tiáo hěn pián yi.
turns.english: Okay, the cafeteria's steamed buns and noodles are very cheap.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 下节课在第二教学楼三楼。
turns.pinyin: Xià jié kè zài dì èr jiào xué lóu sān lóu.
turns.english: Next class is on the 3rd floor of Teaching Building No. 2.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 教学楼离宿舍有点儿远，我们快走吧。
turns.pinyin: Jiào xué lóu lí sù shè yǒu diǎnr yuǎn, wǒ men kuài zǒu ba.
turns.english: The teaching building is a bit far from dorms, let's walk fast.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请问留学生宿舍在几号楼？
turns.pinyin: Qǐng wèn liú xué sheng sù shè zài jǐ hào lóu?
turns.english: Excuse me, which building is the international student dorm?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 在操场后面的五号宿舍楼。
turns.pinyin: Zài cāo chǎng hòu mian de wǔ hào sù shè lóu.
turns.english: In Building 5 behind the sports ground.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 晚上去操场跑步的人很多。
turns.pinyin: Wǎn shang qù cāo chǎng pǎo bù de rén hěn duō.
turns.english: Many people go to run on the sports ground at night.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 操场的跑道很宽很平整。
turns.pinyin: Cāo chǎng de pǎo dào hěn kuān hěn píng zhěng.
turns.english: The track on the sports ground is wide and flat.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 学校的游泳池今天开放吗？
turns.pinyin: Xué xiào de yóu yǒng chí jīn tiān kāi fàng ma?
turns.english: Is the school swimming pool open today?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 开放，水很干净，温度也合适。
turns.pinyin: Kāi fàng, shuǐ hěn gān jìng, wēn dù yě hé shì.
turns.english: Open, the water is clean and temperature is suitable.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请问离学校最近的地铁站在哪儿？
turns.pinyin: Qǐng wèn lí xué xiào zuì jìn de dì tiě zhàn zài nǎr?
turns.english: Excuse me, where is the nearest subway station to school?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 就在学校东门外面，走两分钟就到。
turns.pinyin: Jiù zài xué xiào dōng mén wài miàn, zǒu liǎng fēn zhōng jiù dào.
turns.english: Right outside the east gate, two minutes walk.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请问学校里面有停车场吗？
turns.pinyin: Qǐng wèn xué xiào lǐ miàn yǒu tíng chē chǎng ma?
turns.english: Excuse me, is there a parking lot inside the school?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 教学楼后面有一个很大的停车场。
turns.pinyin: Jiào xué lóu hòu mian yǒu yī ge dà de tíng chē chǎng.
turns.english: Behind the classroom building there is a large parking lot.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这里的校园真美丽，树木很高大。
turns.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de xiào yuán zhēn měi lì, shù mù hěn gāo dà.
turns.english: The campus here is really pretty, the trees are so tall.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 欢迎参观我们的百年校园。
turns.pinyin: Huān yíng cān guān wǒ men de bǎi nián xiào yuán.
turns.english: Welcome to tour our century-old campus.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 王先生，请进请进，欢迎来我家做客！
turns.pinyin: Wáng xiān sheng, qǐng jìn qǐng jìn, huān yíng lái wǒ jiā zuò kè!
turns.english: Mr. Wang, please come in, welcome to our home!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 打扰了，你的书房真亮堂！
turns.pinyin: Dǎ rǎo le, nǐ de shū fáng zhēn liàng tang!
turns.english: Pardon the intrusion, your study is really bright!

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这个书房的书架上摆满了各种书。
turns.pinyin: Zhè ge shū fáng de shū jià shang bǎi mǎn le gè zhǒng shū.
turns.english: The bookshelves in this study are filled with various books.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我平时经常在书房看书和写字。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ píng shí jīng cháng zài shū fáng kàn shū hé xiě zì.
turns.english: I often read and write in the study normally.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请吃西瓜，夏天吃西瓜最解渴了。
turns.pinyin: Qǐng chī xī guā, xià tiān chī xī guā zuì jiě kě le.
turns.english: Please eat watermelon, eating watermelon in summer is most quenching.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 谢谢，这个西瓜非常甜又新鲜。
turns.pinyin: Xiè xie, zhè ge xī guā fēi cháng tián yòu xīn xiān.
turns.english: Thanks, this watermelon is very sweet and fresh.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这道烤牛肉的味道太香了！
turns.pinyin: Zhè dào kǎo niú ròu de wèi dào tài xiāng le!
turns.english: The taste of this roasted beef is so fragrant!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 多吃一点儿，还有烤鸡肉呢。
turns.pinyin: Duō chī yī diǎnr, hái yǒu kǎo jī ròu ne.
turns.english: Eat a bit more, there's also roast chicken.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这个炖鸡肉比上次做的更好吃。
turns.pinyin: Zhè ge dùn jī ròu bǐ shàng cì zuò de gèng hǎo chī.
turns.english: This stewed chicken is tastier than last time.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 因为今天放了新鲜的甜玉米。
turns.pinyin: Yīn wèi jīn tiān fàng le xīn xiān de tián yù mǐ.
turns.english: Because fresh sweet corn was added today.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 尝尝煮玉米吧，刚从农场买的。
turns.pinyin: Cháng chang zhǔ yù mǐ ba, gāng cóng nóng chǎng mǎi de.
turns.english: Taste the boiled corn, just bought from the farm.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 这个玉米真甜，特别好喝的热汤。
turns.pinyin: Zhè ge yù mǐ zhēn tián, tè bié hǎo hē de rè tāng.
turns.english: This corn is really sweet, especially nice hot soup.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你家的猫在沙发上睡觉，好可爱。
turns.pinyin: Nǐ jiā de māo zài shā fā shang shuì jiào, hǎo kě ài.
turns.english: Your cat is sleeping on the sofa, so cute.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 这只猫很聪明，听到名字就会跑过来。
turns.pinyin: Zhè zhī māo hěn cōng ming, tīng dào míng zi jiù huì pǎo guò lai.
turns.english: This cat is smart, runs over when hearing its name.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 墙上的这张老照片是你的家人吗？
turns.pinyin: Qiáng shang de zhè zhāng lǎo zhào piàn shì nǐ de jiā rén ma?
turns.english: Is this old photo on the wall your family?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，这是我们一家人的合影。
turns.pinyin: Duì, zhè shì wǒ men yī jiā rén de hé yǐng.
turns.english: Yes, this is our whole family photo.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这首歌真好听，是谁唱的？
turns.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē zhēn hǎo tīng, shì shéi chàng de?
turns.english: This song is so nice to listen to, who sang it?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 是一位很有名的中国流行歌手。
turns.pinyin: Shì yī wèi hěn yǒu míng de zhōng guó liú xíng gē shǒu.
turns.english: It is a very famous Chinese pop singer.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你的弟弟正在做数学作业吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ de dì di zhèng zài zuò shù xué zuò yè ma?
turns.english: Is your younger brother doing math homework?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，弟弟学习很聪明很努力。
turns.pinyin: Duì, dì di xué xí hěn cōng ming hěn nǔ lì.
turns.english: Yes, younger brother studies smartly and diligently.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你在上海生活了多少年？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ zài shàng hǎi shēng huó le duō shao nián?
turns.english: How many years have you lived in Shanghai?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我出生在上海，在那里长大的。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ chū shēng zài shàng hǎi, zài nà lǐ zhǎng dà de.
turns.english: I was born in Shanghai and grew up there.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你小时候住在香港吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎo shí hou zhù zài xiāng gǎng ma?
turns.english: Did you live in Hong Kong when you were little?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，我在香港读完了小学。
turns.pinyin: Duì, wǒ zài xiāng gǎng dú wán le xiǎo xué.
turns.english: Yes, I finished primary school in Hong Kong.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你七岁开始上小学吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ qī suì kāi shǐ shàng xiǎo xué ma?
turns.english: Did you start primary school at age seven?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，六岁上幼儿园，七岁上小学。
turns.pinyin: Duì, liù suì shàng yòu ér yuán, qī suì shàng xiǎo xué.
turns.english: Yes, kindergarten at six, primary school at seven.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你和李明是中学同学吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ hé lǐ míng shì zhōng xué tóng xué ma?
turns.english: Are you and Li Ming middle school classmates?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，我们从中学起就是好朋友。
turns.pinyin: Duì, wǒ men cóng zhōng xué qǐ jiù shì hǎo péng you.
turns.english: Yes, we've been good friends since middle school.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 小时候你最喜欢看什么动画片？
turns.pinyin: Xiǎo shí hou nǐ zuì xǐ huan kàn shén me dòng huà piàn?
turns.english: What cartoon did you like watching most as a child?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我最喜欢看孙悟空的动画片。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐ huan kàn sūn wù kōng de dòng huà piàn.
turns.english: I liked watching the Monkey King cartoon most.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 周末晚上我们一起玩桌游吧！
turns.pinyin: Zhōu mò wǎn shang wǒ men yī qǐ wán zhuō yóu ba!
turns.english: Let's play board games together on weekend night!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好啊，现在的桌游很有挑战性。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo a, xiàn zài de zhuō yóu hěn yǒu tiǎo zhàn xìng.
turns.english: Sure, modern board games are very challenging.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你打算什么时候出国留学？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ dǎ suàn shén me shí hou chū guó liú xué?
turns.english: When do you plan to go abroad to study?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 明年九月，去英国读研究生。
turns.pinyin: Míng nián jiǔ yuè, qù yīng guó dú yán jiū shēng.
turns.english: Next September, going to the UK for grad school.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 去年你去哪里旅行了？
turns.pinyin: Qù nián nǐ qù nǎ lǐ lǚ xíng le?
turns.english: Where did you travel last year?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我去日本旅行了两个星期。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ qù rì běn lǚ xíng le liǎng ge xīng qī.
turns.english: I went to Japan for travel for two weeks.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 小明，你长大了，是小伙子了！
turns.pinyin: Xiǎo míng, nǐ zhǎng dà le, shì xiǎo huǒ zi le!
turns.english: Xiao Ming, you've grown up into a young man!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 时间过得真快，我已经二十岁了。
turns.pinyin: Shí jiān guò de zhēn kuài, wǒ yǐ jīng èr shí suì le.
turns.english: Time passes so fast, I am already twenty.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你最近工作生活忙不忙？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ zuì jìn gōng zuò shēng huó máng bu máng?
turns.english: Is your work and life busy lately?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 挺忙的，每天都有很多事情。
turns.pinyin: Tǐng máng de, měi tiān dōu yǒu hěn duō shì qing.
turns.english: Quite busy, many things every day.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 周末天气很好，我们去爬山吧！
turns.pinyin: Zhōu mò tiān qì hěn hǎo, wǒ men qù pá shān ba!
turns.english: The weather is great this weekend, let's go climb mountains!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好啊，好久没有去爬山了。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo a, hǎo jiǔ méi yǒu qù pá shān le.
turns.english: Sure, haven't climbed mountains in a long time.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 周日你想去郊区湖边钓鱼吗？
turns.pinyin: Zhōu rì nǐ xiǎng qù jiāo qū hú biān diào yú ma?
turns.english: Do you want to go fishing by the suburb lake on Sunday?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 钓鱼很安静很放松，我想去。
turns.pinyin: Diào yú hěn ān jìng hěn fàng sōng, wǒ xiǎng qù.
turns.english: Fishing is quiet and relaxing, I want to go.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 我们去体育馆打乒乓球吧。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ men qù tǐ yù guǎn dǎ pīng pāng qiú ba.
turns.english: Let's go to the gym to play table tennis.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好，中国人都喜欢打乒乓球。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo, zhōng guó rén dōu xǐ huan dǎ pīng pāng qiú.
turns.english: Okay, Chinese people all like playing ping pong.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 后天就要期末考试了，你紧张吗？
turns.pinyin: Hòu tiān jiù yào qī mò kǎo shì le, nǐ jǐn zhāng ma?
turns.english: The final exam is the day after tomorrow, are you nervous?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 有点儿紧张，我正在认真复习。
turns.pinyin: Yǒu diǎnr jǐn zhāng, wǒ zhèng zài rèn zhēn fù xí.
turns.english: A bit nervous, I am reviewing diligently.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 今天你在家复习历史课吗？
turns.pinyin: Jīn tiān nǐ zài jiā fù xí lì shǐ kè ma?
turns.english: Are you reviewing history class at home today?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，还有很多重点需要复习。
turns.pinyin: Duì, hái yǒu hěn duō zhòng diǎn xū yào fù xí.
turns.english: Yes, there are still many key points to review.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 面试前不要太紧张，深呼吸。
turns.pinyin: Miàn shì qián bù yào tài jǐn zhāng, shēn hū xī.
turns.english: Don't be too nervous before interview, breathe deep.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 谢谢你，加油！我能做好。
turns.pinyin: Xiè xie nǐ, jiā yóu! Wǒ néng zuò hǎo.
turns.english: Thank you, cheer up! I can do well.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 比赛马上开始了，大家加油！
turns.pinyin: Bǐ sài mǎ shàng kāi shǐ le, dà jiā jiā yóu!
turns.english: The match is starting, everyone cheer up!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我们一定会全力以赴争取胜利。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ men yī dìng huì quán lì yǐ fù zhēng qǔ shèng lì.
turns.english: We will surely go all out for victory.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 我晚上给老朋友打电话聊聊天。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ wǎn shang gěi lǎo péng you dǎ diàn huà liáo liao tiān.
turns.english: I'll call old friends tonight to chat.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好久不见确实应该多联系。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo jiǔ bù jiàn què shí yīng gāi duō lián xì.
turns.english: Haven't seen in long, indeed should contact more.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 王明是我十年前的老朋友。
turns.pinyin: Wáng míng shì wǒ shí nián qián de lǎo péng you.
turns.english: Wang Ming is my old friend from ten years ago.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 老朋友见面一定有很多话要说。
turns.pinyin: Lǎo péng you jiàn miàn yī dìng yǒu hěn duō huà yào shuō.
turns.english: Old friends meeting will surely have lots to say.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 出门记得带钥匙和雨伞。
turns.pinyin: Chū mén jì de dài yào shi hé yǔ sǎn.
turns.english: Remember to take keys and umbrella when going out.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的妈妈，我出门了，再见！
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de mā ma, wǒ chū mén le, zài jiàn!
turns.english: Okay Mom, I'm heading out, bye!

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 飞往纽约的飞机几点起飞？
turns.pinyin: Fēi wǎng niǔ yuē de fēi jī jǐ diǎn qǐ fēi?
turns.english: What time does the plane flying to New York take off?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 飞机上午十点半准时起飞。
turns.pinyin: Fēi jī shàng wǔ shí diǎn bàn zhǔn shí qǐ fēi.
turns.english: The plane takes off on time at 10:30 AM.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 我们坐出租车去首都机场吧。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ men zuò chū zū chē qù shǒu dū jī chǎng ba.
turns.english: Let's take a taxi to the Capital Airport.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好，现在出发时间刚好够用。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo, xiàn zài chū fā shí jiān gāng hǎo gòu yòng.
turns.english: Okay, departing now leaves just enough time.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 我们坐出租车去希尔顿酒店吧。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ men zuò chū zū chē qù xī ěr dùn jiǔ diàn ba.
turns.english: Let's take a taxi to the Hilton Hotel.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，坐好系上安全带。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, zuò hǎo jì shàng ān quán dài.
turns.english: Okay, sit tight and fasten seatbelt.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请问这家酒店有空房间吗？
turns.pinyin: Qǐng wèn zhè jiā jiǔ diàn yǒu kōng fáng jiān ma?
turns.english: Does this hotel have vacant rooms?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 有的，请出示您的护照办理入住。
turns.pinyin: Yǒu de, qǐng chū shì nín de hù zhào bàn lǐ rù zhù.
turns.english: Yes, please present your passport to check in.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请出示您的中国护照。
turns.pinyin: Qǐng chū shì nín de zhōng guó hù zhào.
turns.english: Please present your Chinese passport.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，护照和登机牌给您。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, hù zhào hé dēng jī pái gěi nín.
turns.english: Okay, here are the passport and boarding pass.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请问公交站在哪里？
turns.pinyin: Qǐng wèn gōng jiāo zhàn zài nǎ lǐ?
turns.english: Excuse me, where is the bus station?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 就在马路对面，过天桥就是。
turns.pinyin: Jiù zài mǎ lù duì miàn, guò tiān qiáo jiù shì.
turns.english: Right across the street, just cross the footbridge.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 飞机快起飞了，我们会迟到吗？
turns.pinyin: Fēi jī kuài qǐ fēi le, wǒ men huì chí dào ma?
turns.english: The plane is about to take off, will we be late?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 别着急，还有五十分钟呢。
turns.pinyin: Bié zháo jí, hái yǒu wǔ shí fēn zhōng ne.
turns.english: Don't worry, there's still fifty minutes.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你去过美国纽约吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ qù guo měi guó niǔ yuē ma?
turns.english: Have you been to New York, USA?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 去过，纽约是一座繁华的大城市。
turns.pinyin: Qù guo, niǔ yuē shì yī zuò fán huá de dà chéng shì.
turns.english: Yes, New York is a bustling metropolis.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你喜欢坐飞机还是坐高铁？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ xǐ huan zuò fēi jī hái shi zuò gāo tiě?
turns.english: Do you like taking airplanes or high-speed rail?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 长途旅行我更喜欢坐飞机。
turns.pinyin: Cháng tú lǚ xíng wǒ gèng xǐ huan zuò fēi jī.
turns.english: For long trips I prefer taking an airplane.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 我们几点从酒店出发？
turns.pinyin: Wǒ men jǐ diǎn cóng jiǔ diàn chū fā?
turns.english: What time do we depart from the hotel?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 上午八点四十分准时出发。
turns.pinyin: Shàng wǔ bā diǎn sì shí fēn zhǔn shí chū fā.
turns.english: Depart on time at 8:40 AM.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请问试衣间在哪里？
turns.pinyin: Qǐng wèn shì yī jiān zài nǎ lǐ?
turns.english: Excuse me, where is the fitting room?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 试衣间在前面右转第二间。
turns.pinyin: Shì yī jiān zài qián miàn yòu zhuǎn dì èr jiān.
turns.english: The fitting room is right ahead, turn right at the 2nd door.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这条白色连衣裙真漂亮！
turns.pinyin: Zhè tiáo bái sè lián yī qún zhēn piào liang!
turns.english: This white one-piece dress is so pretty!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 很适合你，穿起来很显气质。
turns.pinyin: Hěn shì hé nǐ, chuān qǐ lai hěn xiǎn qì zhì.
turns.english: Suits you well, looks very elegant.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这条黑色皮带有点儿紧。
turns.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hēi sè pí dài yǒu diǎnr jǐn.
turns.english: This black leather belt is a bit tight.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我给您换一条长一点儿的。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nín huàn yī tiáo cháng yī diǎnr de.
turns.english: I will exchange a slightly longer one for you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这副厚手套冬天戴很暖和。
turns.pinyin: Zhè fù hòu shǒu tào dōng tiān dài hěn nuǎn huo.
turns.english: These thick gloves are very warm to wear in winter.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，这是纯羊毛的牌子。
turns.pinyin: Duì, zhè shì chún yáng máo de pái zi.
turns.english: Yes, this is a pure wool brand.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 我想买两双厚袜子。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi liǎng shuāng hòu wà zi.
turns.english: I want to buy two pairs of thick socks.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 这边有黑色的也有白色的。
turns.pinyin: Zhè biān yǒu hēi sè de yě yǒu bái sè de.
turns.english: Here are black ones and also white ones.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这件大衣今天打折吗？
turns.pinyin: Zhè jiàn dà yī jīn tiān dǎ zhé ma?
turns.english: Is this overcoat on discount today?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 打八折，比原价便宜很多。
turns.pinyin: Dǎ bā zhé, bǐ yuán jià pián yi hěn duō.
turns.english: 20% off, much cheaper than the original price.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这双运动鞋真便宜！
turns.pinyin: Zhè shuāng yùn dòng xié zhēn pián yi!
turns.english: These sneakers are really cheap!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 质量也不错，买一双吧。
turns.pinyin: Zhì liàng yě bù cuò, mǎi yī shuāng ba.
turns.english: Quality is also good, buy a pair.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这条黑色裤子长度刚好。
turns.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hēi sè kù zi cháng dù gāng hǎo.
turns.english: The length of these black pants is just right.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 版型也非常好，显腿长。
turns.pinyin: Bǎn xíng yě fēi cháng hǎo, xiǎn tuǐ cháng.
turns.english: The cut is great too, makes legs look long.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这双黑色的皮鞋有点儿硬。
turns.pinyin: Zhè shuāng hēi sè de pí xié yǒu diǎnr yìng.
turns.english: This pair of black leather shoes is a bit stiff.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 您试试这双软底运动鞋。
turns.pinyin: Nín shì shi zhè shuāng ruǎn dǐ yùn dòng xié.
turns.english: Try this pair of soft-sole sneakers.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 下午我们去步行街逛街吧。
turns.pinyin: Xià wǔ wǒ men qù bù xíng jiē guàng jiē ba.
turns.english: Let's go stroll along the pedestrian street this afternoon.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好，逛累了还可以吃披萨。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo, guàng lèi le hái kě yǐ chī pī sà.
turns.english: Okay, when tired of shopping we can also eat pizza.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 明晚在体育馆有一场演唱会。
turns.pinyin: Míng wǎn zài tǐ yù guǎn yǒu yī chǎng yǎn chàng huì.
turns.english: Tomorrow evening there is a concert at the stadium.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我已经在网上买到门票了！
turns.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ jīng zài wǎng shang mǎi dào mén piào le!
turns.english: I already bought the ticket online!

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 售票处门前排队的人真多。
turns.pinyin: Shòu piào chù mén qián pái duì de rén zhēn duō.
turns.english: There are really many people queuing in front of the box office.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 大家都在等开门买票。
turns.pinyin: Dà jiā dōu zài děng kāi mén mǎi piào.
turns.english: Everyone is waiting for the door to open to buy tickets.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请大家在入口前面排队。
turns.pinyin: Qǐng dà jiā zài rù kǒu qián mian pái duì.
turns.english: Please queue up in front of the entrance.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，我们一个一个进场。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ men yī ge yī ge jìn chǎng.
turns.english: Okay, let's enter the venue one by one.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请问大剧场的入口在哪里？
turns.pinyin: Qǐng wèn dà jù chǎng de rù kǒu zài nǎ lǐ?
turns.english: Excuse me, where is the entrance to the grand theater?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 穿过广场就是东入口了。
turns.pinyin: Chuān guò guǎng chǎng jiù shì dōng rù kǒu le.
turns.english: Pass through the plaza and you reach the East Entrance.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 我们的座位在第六排中间。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ men de zuò wèi zài dì liù pái zhōng jiān.
turns.english: Our seats are in the middle of Row 6.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 这个位置视线非常好！
turns.pinyin: Zhè ge wèi zhi shì xiàn fēi cháng hǎo!
turns.english: The line of sight from this position is great!

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 我想买一件演唱会的纪念品。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī jiàn yǎn chàng huì de jì niàn pǐn.
turns.english: I want to buy a concert souvenir.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 那顶纪念帽子很好看。
turns.pinyin: Nà dǐng jì niàn mào zi hěn hǎo kàn.
turns.english: That commemorative hat looks very nice.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 今晚就要见到偶像了，真兴奋！
turns.pinyin: Jīn wǎn jiù yào jiàn dào ǒu xiàng le, zhēn xīng fèn!
turns.english: Seeing the idol tonight, really excited!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我也特别兴奋，期待了很久。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ yě tè bié xīng fèn, qī dài le hěn jiǔ.
turns.english: I'm also super excited, anticipated for long.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 寒假假期你打算去哪里玩？
turns.pinyin: Hán jià jià qī nǐ dǎ suàn qù nǎ lǐ wán?
turns.english: Where do you plan to go for winter vacation?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我和朋友计划去哈尔滨滑雪。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ hé péng you jì huà qù hā ěr bīn huá xuě.
turns.english: My friends and I plan to ski in Harbin.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 我可以给你拍几张舞台照片吗？
turns.pinyin: Wǒ kě yǐ gěi nǐ pāi jǐ zhāng wǔ tái zhào piàn ma?
turns.english: Can I take a few stage photos for you?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好啊，用手机横着拍。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo a, yòng shǒu jī héng zhe pāi.
turns.english: Sure, shoot horizontally with the phone.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 今年年假你有什么出行计划？
turns.pinyin: Jīn nián nián jià nǐ yǒu shén me chū xíng jì huà?
turns.english: What travel plans do you have for annual leave this year?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 计划去国外海边度假一周。
turns.pinyin: Jì huà qù guó wài hǎi biān dù jià yī zhōu.
turns.english: Plan to vacation abroad by the sea for a week.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 九点半在第三会议室开会。
turns.pinyin: Jiǔ diǎn bàn zài dì sān huì yì shì kāi huì.
turns.english: Meeting at 9:30 in Conference Room 3.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，会议室的投影仪已经准备好了。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, huì yì shì de tóu yǐng yí yǐ jīng zhǔn bèi hǎo le.
turns.english: Okay, the conference room projector is ready.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请问张经理的办公室在哪一层？
turns.pinyin: Qǐng wèn zhāng jīng lǐ de bàn gōng shì zài nǎ yī céng?
turns.english: Excuse me, which floor is Manager Zhang's office on?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 经理办公室在八层左手边。
turns.pinyin: Jīng lǐ bàn gōng shì zài bā céng zuǒ shǒu biān.
turns.english: The manager's office is on the 8th floor to the left.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 赵小月是公司市场部的同事。
turns.pinyin: Zhào xiǎo yuè shì gōng sī shì chǎng bù de tóng shì.
turns.english: Zhao Xiaoyue is a colleague in the marketing department.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 她业务能力很强，工作很热情。
turns.pinyin: Tā yè wù néng lì hěn qiáng, gōng zuò hěn rè qíng.
turns.english: Her professional skill is strong, work enthusiasm high.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 老板今天签署了新的合作合同。
turns.pinyin: Lǎo bǎn jīn tiān qiān shǔ le xīn de hé zuò hé tong.
turns.english: The boss signed the new partnership contract today.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 这对我们公司是一个重要发展。
turns.pinyin: Zhè duì wǒ men gōng sī shì yī ge zhòng yào fā zhǎn.
turns.english: This is an important development for our company.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 今天参加面试要穿白色衬衫。
turns.pinyin: Jīn tiān cān jiā miàn shì yào chuān bái sè chèn shān.
turns.english: Must wear a white shirt to attend interview today.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 穿衬衫看起来专业又稳重。
turns.pinyin: Chuān chèn shān kàn qǐ lai zhuān yè yòu wěn zhòng.
turns.english: Wearing a shirt looks professional and steady.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请把这份英文合同翻译成中文。
turns.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè fèn yīng wén hé tong fān yì chéng zhōng wén.
turns.english: Please translate this English contract into Chinese.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，翻译工作下午两点前完成。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, fān yì gōng zuò xià wǔ liǎng diǎn qián wán chéng.
turns.english: Okay, translation finished before 2 PM.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这个项目对公司非常重要。
turns.pinyin: Zhè ge xiàng mù duì gōng sī fēi cháng zhòng yào.
turns.english: This project is very important to the company.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 请经理放心，我们一定努力做好。
turns.pinyin: Qǐng jīng lǐ fàng xīn, wǒ men yī dìng nǔ lì zuò hǎo.
turns.english: Rest assured manager, we'll strive to do it well.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 今晚欢迎新同事，你订了饭馆吗？
turns.pinyin: Jīn wǎn huān yíng xīn tóng shì, nǐ dìng le fàn guǎn ma?
turns.english: Welcoming new colleagues tonight, booked a restaurant?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 订好了，就在公司对面的川菜馆。
turns.pinyin: Dìng hǎo le, jiù zài gōng sī duì miàn de chuān cài guǎn.
turns.english: Booked, right at the Sichuan restaurant across from company.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 感谢贵公司热情的欢迎接待。
turns.pinyin: Gǎn xiè guì gōng sī rè qíng de huān yíng jiē dài.
turns.english: Thank your company for the warm and enthusiastic welcome.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 客气了，非常高兴与您合作。
turns.pinyin: Kè qi le, fēi cháng gāo xìng yǔ nín hé zuò.
turns.english: Too kind, very glad to cooperate with you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 李先生，您来点菜，想喝什么红酒？
turns.pinyin: Lǐ xiān sheng, nín lái diǎn cài, xiǎng hē shén me hóng jiǔ?
turns.english: Mr. Li, you order the dishes, what red wine would you like?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 随便点几样招牌菜就好。
turns.pinyin: Suí biàn diǎn jǐ yàng zhāo pái cài jiù hǎo.
turns.english: Just order whatever signature dishes are good.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 老师，我的身份证刚刚丢了。
turns.pinyin: Lǎo shī, wǒ de shēn fèn zhèng gāng gang diū le.
turns.english: Teacher, my ID card was just lost.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 别急，去失物招领处问问看。
turns.pinyin: Bié jí, qù shī wù zhāo lǐng chù wèn wen kàn.
turns.english: Don't rush, go ask at the lost and found.

turns.english: Yes, on weekends I often read novels to pass time.

turns.hanzi: 是变速自行车，骑山路也很轻松。
turns.pinyin: Shì biàn sù zì xíng chē, qí shān lù yě hěn qīng sōng.
turns.english: It's a multi-gear bike, easy on hills too.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 运动完洗澡真舒服。
turns.pinyin: Yùn dòng wán xǐ zǎo zhēn shū fu.
turns.english: Taking a shower after sports is so comfortable.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 洗完澡整个人都轻松了。
turns.pinyin: Xǐ wán zǎo zhěng ge rén dōu qīng sōng le.
turns.english: The whole body is relaxed after bathing.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 糟了，我出门忘带钥匙了！
turns.pinyin: Zāo le, wǒ chū mén wàng dài yào shi le!
turns.english: Darn, I forgot my keys when going out!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 别着急，我身上有钥匙，我来开门。
turns.pinyin: Bié zháo jí, wǒ shēn shang yǒu yào shi, wǒ lái kāi mén.
turns.english: Don't worry, I have keys on me, I'll unlock.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你每天睡前都写日记吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ měi tiān shuì qián dōu xiě rì jì ma?
turns.english: Do you write a diary every night before sleep?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，写日记记录一天的生活。
turns.pinyin: Duì, xiě rì jì jì lù yī tiān de shēng huó.
turns.english: Yes, writing a diary records the day's life.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 吃早饭的时候听听新闻吧。
turns.pinyin: Chī zǎo fàn de shí hou tīng ting xīn wén ba.
turns.english: Listen to the news while eating breakfast.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，今天有什么重要新闻？
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, jīn tiān yǒu shén me zhòng yào xīn wén?
turns.english: Okay, what important news is there today?

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这本日本漫画非常搞笑。
turns.pinyin: Zhè běn rì běn màn huà fēi cháng gǎo xiào.
turns.english: This Japanese manga comic is very funny.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 借我看两天好吗？我也爱看漫画。
turns.pinyin: Jiè wǒ kàn liǎng tiān hǎo ma? Wǒ yě ài kàn màn huà.
turns.english: Lend it to me for two days? I love manga too.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 今天中午太忙了，点外卖吃吧。
turns.pinyin: Jīn tiān zhōng wǔ tài máng le, diǎn wài mài chī ba.
turns.english: Too busy this noon, let's order takeout to eat.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的，我想吃鸡蛋炒饭加辣椒。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ xiǎng chī jī dàn chǎo fàn jiā là jiāo.
turns.english: Okay, I want egg fried rice with chili pepper.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这个菜里放了很多新鲜辣椒。
turns.pinyin: Zhè ge cài lǐ fàng le hěn duō xīn xiān là jiāo.
turns.english: A lot of fresh chili peppers were put in this dish.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 吃起来特别辣，但也特别香。
turns.pinyin: Chī qǐ lai tè bié là, dàn yě tè bié xiāng.
turns.english: Tastes especially spicy, but also very fragrant.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 早上煮了两个热鸡蛋。
turns.pinyin: Zǎo shang zhǔ le liǎng ge rè jī dàn.
turns.english: Boiled two hot eggs this morning.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 鸡蛋营养丰富，我全吃完了。
turns.pinyin: Jī dàn yíng yǎng fēng fù, wǒ quán chī wán le.
turns.english: Eggs are rich in nutrition, I ate all.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你的数学作业写完了吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ de shù xué zuò yè xiě wán le ma?
turns.english: Is your math homework finished?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 马上写完了，还差最后两道题。
turns.pinyin: Mǎ shàng xiě wán le, hái chà zuì hòu liǎng dào tí.
turns.english: Finishing right away, only last 2 questions left.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 下午工作有点儿困了。
turns.pinyin: Xià wǔ gōng zuò yǒu diǎnr kùn le.
turns.english: Feeling a bit sleepy working this afternoon.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 喝杯热咖啡提提神吧。
turns.pinyin: Hē bēi rè kā fēi tí ti shén ba.
turns.english: Drink a hot coffee to refresh.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 冰箱里还有冰汽水吗？
turns.pinyin: Bīng xiāng lǐ hái yǒu bīng qì shuǐ ma?
turns.english: Is there still iced soda in the fridge?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 有两罐柠檬味汽水，给你拿一罐。
turns.pinyin: Yǒu liǎng guàn níng méng wèi qì shuǐ, gěi nǐ ná yī guàn.
turns.english: There are two lemon sodas, I'll fetch one for you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你能帮我把这些书搬过去吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ néng bāng wǒ bǎ zhè xiē shū bān guò qu ma?
turns.english: Can you help me move these books over?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 没问题，我力气大，我来搬。
turns.pinyin: Méi wèn tí, wǒ lì qi dà, wǒ lái bān.
turns.english: No problem, I have big strength, let me carry.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 晚饭后去湖边散步怎么样？
turns.pinyin: Wǎn fàn hòu qù hú biān sàn bù zěn me yàng?
turns.english: How about walking by the lake after dinner?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 很好，散步对身体健康很有好处。
turns.pinyin: Hěn hǎo, sàn bù duì shēn tǐ jiàn kāng hěn yǒu hǎo chu.
turns.english: Great, walking is very good for health.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你到哪儿了？大家都在等你。
turns.pinyin: Nǐ dào nǎr le? Dà jiā dōu zài děng nǐ.
turns.english: Where have you arrived? Everyone is waiting.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 马上就到，我已经在地铁站门口了。
turns.pinyin: Mǎ shàng jiù dào, wǒ yǐ jīng zài dì tiě zhàn mén kǒu le.
turns.english: Arriving right away, already at subway gate.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 明天要早起，今晚早点儿睡觉吧。
turns.pinyin: Míng tiān yào zǎo qǐ, jīn wǎn zǎo diǎnr shuì jiào ba.
turns.english: Need to wake early tomorrow, sleep earlier tonight.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好的妈妈，我收拾好书包就睡。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo de mā ma, wǒ shōu shi hǎo shū bāo jiù shuì.
turns.english: Okay Mom, I'll sleep once backpack is packed.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你经常在这个购物网站买东西吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ jīng cháng zài zhè ge gòu wù wǎng zhàn mǎi dōng xi ma?
turns.english: Do you often shop on this shopping website?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，网站上的商品很全，价格很便宜。
turns.pinyin: Duì, wǎng zhàn shang de shāng pǐn hěn quán, jià gé hěn pián yi.
turns.english: Yes, goods on the site are comprehensive, prices cheap.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请问您用现金还是信用卡支付？
turns.pinyin: Qǐng wèn nín yòng xiàn jīn hái shi xìn yòng kǎ zhī fù?
turns.english: Do you pay with cash or credit card?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我刷信用卡，一共三百块对吧？
turns.pinyin: Wǒ shuā xìn yòng kǎ, yī gòng sān bǎi kuài duì ba?
turns.english: I swipe credit card, 300 yuan total right?

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这款时尚的手表多少钱？
turns.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn shí shàng de shǒu biǎo duō shao qián?
turns.english: How much is this fashionable watch?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 原价八百块，今天打九折。
turns.pinyin: Yuán jià bā bǎi kuài, jīn tiān dǎ jiǔ zhé.
turns.english: Original 800 yuan, 10% off today.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这双白色运动鞋穿起来真舒服。
turns.pinyin: Zhè shuāng bái sè yùn dòng xié chuān qǐ lai zhēn shū fu.
turns.english: Wearing these white sneakers feels so comfy.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 款式很时尚，跑步打球都合适。
turns.pinyin: Kuǎn shì hěn shí shàng, pǎo bù dǎ qiú dōu hé shì.
turns.english: The style is fashionable, good for running or ball.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这家店的售后服务真让人满意。
turns.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de shòu hòu fú wù zhēn ràng rén mǎn yì.
turns.english: This shop's after-sales service is truly satisfying.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 感谢您的支持，欢迎再次光临！
turns.pinyin: Gǎn xiè nín de zhī chí, huān yíng zài cì guāng lín!
turns.english: Thank you for support, welcome again!

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请问我的网上订单发货了吗？
turns.pinyin: Qǐng wèn wǒ de wǎng shang dìng dān fā huò le ma?
turns.english: Has my online order shipped?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 您的订单已发出，明天就能送到。
turns.pinyin: Nín de dìng dān yǐ fā chū, míng tiān jiù néng sòng dào.
turns.english: Your order has been sent, arrives tomorrow.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这件衣服尺寸不合适，可以退吗？
turns.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fu chǐ cùn bù hé shì, kě yǐ tuì ma?
turns.english: This clothing size doesn't fit, can it be returned?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 七天内支持退货，请保留包装。
turns.pinyin: Qī tiān nèi zhī chí tuì huò, qǐng bǎo liú bāo zhuāng.
turns.english: Supports returns within 7 days, keep packaging.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请先登录您的个人账号。
turns.pinyin: Qǐng xiān dēng lù nín de gè rén zhàng hào.
turns.english: Please log into your personal account first.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 已经输入账号和密码了。
turns.pinyin: Yǐ jīng shū rù zhàng hào hé mì mǎ le.
turns.english: Already entered account and password.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 最近快递怎么这么慢？
turns.pinyin: Zuì jìn kuài dì zěn me zhè me màn?
turns.english: Why is express delivery so slow lately?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 网上购物节订单太多，所以慢。
turns.pinyin: Wǎng shang gòu wù jié dìng dān tài duō, suǒ yǐ màn.
turns.english: Online shopping festival has too many orders, so it's slow.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 新房子的家具都在网上买好了。
turns.pinyin: Xīn fáng zi de jiā jù dōu zài wǎng shang mǎi hǎo le.
turns.english: The new house's furniture was all bought online.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 质量不错，沙发和餐桌都很漂亮。
turns.pinyin: Zhì liàng bù cuò, shā fā hé cān zhuō dōu hěn piào liang.
turns.english: Quality is nice, sofa and dining table look pretty.
